items.title: Four Nepali Americans seek seats in three US state legislatures
items.desc: The four Democratic candidates are running in Maryland, New Hampshire and New York in the November 3 midterm elections.

items.title: Eight inmates escape Dolpa prison through tunnel dug beneath compound
items.desc: The escape, three days after a new duty in-charge was assigned, has raised questions about prison security and surveillance. Five of the escapees were serving sentences for rape cases, and three were involved in theft cases.

items.title: Eight injured in fire at steel factory in Banke
items.desc: An electrical short circuit in three furnaces triggered the blaze at Ambe Steels in Janaki Rural Municipality. Two of the injured have been referred to Lucknow for further treatment.

items.title: Army helicopter to rescue six Indian tourists stranded by snow in Dolpa
items.desc: The tourists are stranded in Danigad of Shey Phoksundo Rural Municipality as several days of heavy snowfall disrupt life in the high Himalayan region.

items.title: Bad weather disrupts flights at several airports; two international flights diverted
items.desc: Bharatpur, Surkhet and Bhairahawa airports remain closed, while poor visibility and low cloud cover affect operations at Kathmandu airport.

items.title: Parsa stakeholders agree on joint efforts to clean up polluted Sirsiya river
items.desc: Industries along the Parsa-Bara industrial corridor will be barred from discharging untreated wastewater into the river and required to operate treatment plants around the clock.

items.title: Nepali players take the lead in NPL’s Player of the Match awards
items.desc: After two seasons of an even split, Nepali cricketers have edged ahead of overseas players, winning 38 of the 70 awards handed out so far.

items.title: Bankers fear loan misuse ruling could shake confidence in lending
items.desc: With excess liquidity, historically low interest rates and weak credit demand, bankers warn that the prospect of criminal cases against borrowers who divert loan funds could further dampen lending, particularly if past loans are affected.

items.title: Fiction: The village voice
items.desc: As its young people leave in search of better lives, a village begins to dream of a brighter future with the rumoured arrival of a supermarket chain.

items.title: The NPL match that needed a diplomatic breakthrough
items.desc: By 3:30pm, the grey skies over Kirtipur had finally cleared. What followed was a race against the clock to get the match underway.

items.title: Nepal and Bhutan propose dedicated COP31 agenda on 1.5°C warming in mountain regions
items.desc: In a formal submission addressed to the UNFCCC, the Himalayan nations urge the inclusion of the proposed agenda item in the supplementary provisional agenda of COP31.

items.title: Sunkoshi Marin contract cancellation defers Madhesh irrigation dream
items.desc: The decision comes after three Chinese companies qualified for the final round, raising fresh uncertainty over a project meant to irrigate 122,000 hectares across five districts.

items.title: Nepal has the creativity and talent to build its own industries. What it needs is government support
items.desc: The government must be a part of these endeavours, understanding how such businesses can save communities.

items.title: How Nepal’s diverse voices are shaping political awakening and responding to modern challenges
items.desc: To channel great moments of awakening, we need political management: governing politicians and an opposition that cautions and advises.

items.title: Who ordered the police crackdown on journalists?
items.desc: Police sources say the operation to detain journalists and pressure them into revealing their sources followed discussions between senior officials at the prime minister’s secretariat and the home ministry.

items.title: Biratnagar defeat Sudurpaschim by 35 runs
items.desc: Chasing a target of 106 in a rain-shortened five-over match, Sudurpaschim managed only 70 for three at the TU International Cricket Ground on Saturday.

items.title: Biratnagar set Sudurpaschim a daunting 106-run target
items.desc: Biratnagar Kings scored 105 for two in a rain-shortened five-over match in the Nepal Premier League at the TU International Cricket Ground on Saturday.

items.title: Shabana Azmi on acting, equality and the power of cinema
items.desc: In a conversation with Swastima Khadka at the Kathmandu Film Festival, the veteran Indian actor reflected on her journey from ‘Ankur’ to mainstream hits, her marriage to Javed Akhtar and the responsibility of women artists.

items.title: ‘Elephants in the Fog’ actor Pushpa Lama wins Asia Pacific Screen award
items.desc: The actor was recognised for her portrayal of a member of Nepal’s marginalised kinnar community in Abinash Bikram Shah’s Cannes-winning film.

items.title: Ruling RSP weighs impeachment as a tool for judiciary reform
items.desc: The party’s secretariat has directed its parliamentary party to initiate the process to impeach justices linked to the intermediary Inam Sapkota as party chair Rabi Lamichhane consults the law minister and lawmakers with legal backgrounds.

items.title: Nepal and Mauritius move closer to G2G labour agreement
items.desc: Mauritius has agreed to proceed with Nepal’s proposal for a bilateral deal to recruit Nepali workers, with provisions aimed at reducing recruitment costs and protecting migrant workers’ rights.

items.title: Gen Z protests reach Germany as over 160,000 expected at Halloween rallies
items.desc: The German protests, organised by campaign group Gen Z regelt (Gen ​Z takes charge), are planned in 34 cities, including Berlin, Frankfurt and Munich.

items.title: Ground staff prepare for Saturday’s second match of NPL despite rain
items.desc: Biratnagar Kings and Sudurpaschim Royals are likely to take the field after the opening fixture between Lumbini Lions and Chitwan Rhinos was abandoned without a toss.

items.title: Rising Kulekhani reservoir prompts flood alert along Bagmati river
items.desc: Rautahat authorities warn riverside residents to prepare for possible sudden rises in water levels if water is released from the reservoir in neighbouring Makwanpur district.

items.title: Rain washes out Lumbini-Chitwan match on Saturday
items.desc: Persistent rain leaves Lumbini Lions and Chitwan Rhinos with a point each, while the Biratnagar Kings-Sudurpaschim Royals match is also in doubt.

items.title: Nepse rebounds after Dashain as trading picks up
items.desc: The benchmark index gains 2.13 percent to 2,690.15, while weekly turnover jumps 53 percent to Rs34.39 billion.
